display.purpose: Landing promise and the largest empty-state headings.

label.purpose: Offsets, byte values, labels, metadata, status, and controls.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Small color and 2px translation response on interactive controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single oxide action into the Sample Inspection.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--oxide-dark); border-radius: 0; background: var(--oxide); color: var(--paper-light); font: 0.77rem var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--oxide-dark); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet later-slice action that remains visible but disabled in the PNG slice.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 52px; padding: 13px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); font: 0.77rem var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { border-color: rgba(29, 40, 38, 0.45); color: var(--ink-soft); cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.82; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Sheet Frame
components.description: A single paper workbench containing a coherent route.
components.html:
Sample: PNG

Measured content lives on one sheet.
components.css: .ds-sheet { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(29, 40, 38, 0.42); border-radius: 0; background-color: var(--paper); color: var(--ink); } .ds-sheet::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 14px; pointer-events: none; border: 1px solid rgba(29, 40, 38, 0.26); }

components.name: Structure Row
components.description: A source-ordered semantic item tied to an exact Byte span.
components.css: .ds-structure-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 53px 1fr; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 10px 13px 0; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(29, 40, 38, 0.42); border-left: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); text-align: left; font: 0.75rem var(--mono); } .ds-structure-row:hover { border-left-color: var(--verdigris); } .ds-structure-row[aria-pressed="true"] { border-left-color: var(--oxide); background: rgba(169, 79, 57, 0.08); }

components.name: Selected Byte Span
components.description: The raw bytes remain primary and the exact selected range gets an oxide bracket.
components.css: .ds-byte-cells { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(16, 1fr); border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-byte { padding: 13px 3px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(29, 40, 38, 0.34); color: var(--ink); font: 0.74rem var(--mono); text-align: center; } .ds-byte.is-selected { background: var(--oxide); color: var(--paper-light); } .ds-bracket { position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 0; width: 12.5%; height: calc(100% + 15px); border-top: 2px solid var(--oxide); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--oxide); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Field Note
components.description: The selected Field explains its span, bytes, value, and representation beside the grid.
components.html:
SELECTED FIELD

Width

Image width in pixels.

BYTE SPAN
10–13 · 4 bytes
components.css: .ds-field-note { border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 18px; color: var(--ink); } .ds-field-note small, .ds-field-note dt { color: var(--oxide-dark); font: 0.65rem var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field-note h3 { margin: 8px 0; font: 500 1.5rem/1.1 var(--serif, Georgia); } .ds-field-note p { color: var(--ink-soft); font: 0.9rem/1.45 var(--serif, Georgia); } .ds-field-note dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 87px 1fr; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-note dd { margin: 0; font: 0.83rem var(--serif, Georgia); }

narrative.overview: HexLens is a flat paper-and-ink workbench for connecting raw bytes to the Structures and Fields they support. Serif explanation and monospace measurement stay in separate jobs; thin rules and sparse oxide or verdigris accents carry state without dashboard chrome.

rules.name: The Rare Accent Rule
rules.body: Oxide and verdigris mark meaning or state; they do not decorate every surface.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif carries human explanation while monospace carries measurements and state.

rules.name: The Flat Workbench Rule
rules.body: Use material, rules, and state contrast for depth; do not stack floating cards.

dos: Do keep the real Sample and exact Byte span visible early.
Do preserve the warm paper grain and registration language.
Do label the Source preview as original-file rendering.
donts: Don't turn the workbench into metric tiles or terminal chrome.
Don't add gradients or box shadows.
Don't decode opaque Payload content in the visual layer.
